fields.description: Siphon Life can now be channeled on an allied target. When channeled on an ally, it drains your health to rapidly heal them for 150% of the health you lose.

fields.name: Blood Ties
fields.description: Siphon Life can now be channeled on an allied target. When channeled on an ally, it drains your health to rapidly heal them for 300% of the health you lose.

fields.name: Sanguine Shell
fields.description: Instant. 3-minute cooldown. Instantly slice your own veins, sacrificing 30% of your current health. Grants all party members within 30 yards a massive shield that absorbs all damage equal to 300% of the health you sacrificed. Lasts 15 seconds.

fields.name: Rebuke
fields.description: Stops the spell the target is casting and locks it out of that spell's school for 4 seconds. When it stops a cast, you gain a stack of Conviction.

fields.name: Bulwark Taunt
fields.description: Every enemy within 10 yd attacks you for 4 sec, and your threat on each rises to match its highest.

fields.name: Kick
fields.description: Stops the spell the target is casting and locks it out of that spell's school for 5 seconds. When it stops a cast, you gain 1 combo point.

fields.name: Sap
fields.description: From Stealth, incapacitates an enemy that is not in combat for 20 sec. Any damage ends it. You stay stealthed.

fields.name: Counterspell
fields.description: Stops the spell the target is casting and locks it out of that spell's school for 6 seconds. When it stops a cast, you regain 10% of your maximum mana.

fields.name: Ember Blast
fields.description: Every enemy within 6 yd takes Fire damage and is knocked back 10 yd, and any cast it has under way stops. A boss takes the damage only.

fields.name: Silencing Shot
fields.description: Stops the spell the target is casting and locks it out of that spell's school for 3 seconds. When it stops a cast, your Vault is ready again.

fields.name: Snare Trap
fields.description: Lays a trap at your feet that arms after 2 sec and lasts 60 sec. The first enemy that is not a boss to step on it is incapacitated for 12 sec. Damage breaks it. Only one trap at a time.

fields.name: Hush
fields.description: Stops the spell the target is casting and locks it out of that spell's school for 4 seconds. When it stops a cast, Creeping Blight settles on the target, or gains a stack if it is already there.

fields.name: Grasping Shadows
fields.description: Shrouds the target area in grasping shadows for 10 sec. Enemies inside move 60% slower, and a boss 30% slower.

fields.name: Reactive Strike
fields.aura_description: Your next Righteous Smash costs 2 less Rage.

fields.name: Vengeful Conviction
fields.aura_description: Your next Righteous Smash grants 2 stacks of Conviction.

fields.name: Momentum (crit)
fields.aura_description: Your next Heroic Strike has +50% critical strike chance.

fields.name: Arcane Substrate
fields.aura_description: Your next Biting Cold casts 0.1 sec faster.

fields.name: Arcane Substrate
fields.aura_description: Your next Searing Ember burns 1 sec longer.

fields.name: Bloodlust
fields.aura_description: Physical damage dealt and attack speed increased by 3% a stack.

fields.name: Blood Droplet
fields.aura_description: A droplet of blood. Walk over it for a stack of Bloodlust.
